text: marie: Nightly linkcheck failed for both mkdocs and docusaurus pages, looks like fragment resolution and locale redirects flaked. alex: linkcheck shows two types of failures: missing fragment (e.g. /en-GB/tutorial/#db-screenshot) and an internal redirect loop /tutorial/ -> /en-GB/tutorial/ -> /tutorial/. sam: reproduced locally. For fragments the generated HTML sometimes has ids with a `-1` suffix (e.g. `db-screenshot-1`) while cross-page links target the unsuffixed id. I tracked it to duplicate auto-generated anchors: same image filename used in multiple locales or an explicit inline anchor colliding with remark/docusaurus slugify. jordan: I hit this before when we had inline next to `## Legacy Foo`. Docusaurus/remark-slug appends `-1` to avoid duplicates. Linkcheck then fails if external refs keep the old id. priya: quick fixes: 1) normalize site_url (no trailing slash) to stop redirect loops, 2) relax linkcheck regex to accept `(-\\d+)?` suffixes so CI isn't flaky, 3) add a lint that warns when the same autogenerated id appears across locale dirs. marie: agree on triage: land linkcheck relax to unblock nightly, then follow up with lint + codemod. We should also add a short contributing note recommending explicit anchors for screenshots used across locales. alex: I'll open the linkcheck hotfix PR with a test. PR will tweak the fragment matcher to try both canonical and deduped variants before failing. sam: I'll prototype a grep-based pre-PR checker that computes the slugified ids for images/headers per locale and warns on duplicates. That can be run in CI or as a pre-commit hook. jordan: for content cleanup I can run a small codemod: convert inline HTML anchors near headers into the `{#id}` markdown anchor form or move the explicit anchor so it's not colliding. That makes ids deterministic. I'll prepare a draft script `tools/fix-inline-anchors` and a tests directory. priya: I'll add a small unit test in docs-build tests that simulates duplicated image names across locales to guard against regressions. Also attaching a short PR note about the contributor guidance change. docs-ci-bot: nightly/docs-linkcheck failed (https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9444) :x: | job: docs-linkcheck | duration: 9m marie: timeline: land linkcheck hotfix today, follow up with lint + codemod in two PRs. If the codemod affects many pages, we'll open a single bulk docs PR with a changelog entry so reviewers understand the sweep. alex: tagging the PR `docs:hotfix` and will ping for quick review. Snippet I'll add to contributing.md: ``` // if screenshot is referenced across locales, prefer explicit anchor on the header: ### Database screenshot ![...](img/db.png) ``` sam: good. Also adding a small helper script to list duplicate image filenames across /docs/*/ to catch accidental reuses. marie: perfect. Thanks all 44d Keep me looped on PRs so I can coordinate merge window and avoid breaking release docs. If linkcheck still flakes after the hotfix, we'll run a docs office hour to triage live. jordan: will run the codemod on a small set first and post results. priya: PR for hotfix incoming in 30m. marie: great, thanks.
